verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is an API-first engine: all search, indexing and settings capabilities are exposed 'from a single API'. A versioned OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec is published on the docs site, API reference pages carry multi-language code samples, there are official typed SDKs in ten languages, and SemVer and experimental-feature policies are documented. Community users report building against the API directly. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs 'Try it' runner (the playground is disabled), and long-term-support or deprecation guarantees for API versions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API
Meilisearch publishes its engine's OpenAPI 3.1.0 document on the docs site
